POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.

2. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

3. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.

4. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

8. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.

9. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

10. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

11. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

12. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to computer aided drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain electronic systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.

5. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. A — Information and Communication Technology

7. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Electrical Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of electronic systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
